exchanges: it's official, we're moving to quillhaven in the fall
That's exciting, a fresh start!
boxes everywhere already and we havent even started
The box stage is always chaotic.
my girlfriend sabine labelled everything with colour codes, its intense
Colour coding will make unpacking way easier.
the gf is studying horticulture so half the boxes are just plants
Moving plants is its own adventure.
i'm worried the big fern wont survive teh drive
Keep it out of direct sun in the car and it should be fine.
assuming my old forester even makes it lol
Fingers crossed the old car has one more trip in it.
it's making a weird clicking noise
Might be worth a quick check before the drive.
my cousin nadia offered to help pack after her curling game sunday
That's really nice of her.
different nadia, my dentist, spent my whole cleaning telling me about her archery league
Hard to chat back with a mouth full of tools.
i just nodded a lot
The only possible response, really.
jasper made me promise to watch shogun before we go
He must really love it.
we're gonna have a goodbye movie night at his place
That sounds like a fun send-off.
jasper's dog pemberton will be there too, he's the best boy
A dog at movie night makes it even better.
my coworker ottoline is throwing me a little farewell lunch
That's a lovely send-off from work.
kinda emotional about leaving that job tbh
It makes sense to feel that way after a good team.
grandpa is rereading middlemarch yet again, he says it gets better
Some books really do reward a reread.
he wants me to borrow it after, i said maybe
A very diplomatic answer.
gonna miss tamarind so much, best breakfast burritos in the city
Leaving your go-to spot is always hard.
we'll find a new one i guess
Hunting for a new favourite is part of the fun.
jasper brought his whippet over and it keeps stealing socks out of the boxes
Sock thieves are the worst kind of helpers.
ok taking a break, my back hurts
Good call, rest up.
the new place has a huge window in the kitchen
Great light for all those plants.
and the archivist position there starts right after we land
Perfect timing with the new role.
it's all coming together i think
It really sounds like it is.

questions.message: remind me what book grandpa has going
